summary: Frontend-only check of the iteration_4 fixes on /design-preview, using the public URL and Playwright. All child-page layout fixes PASS. The time-aware greeting PASSES on family but FAILS on center and therapist. CHILD (320 and 390): (1) Providers: at 320 the name block is 164px, the Speech and OT tags wrap onto their own line (tag top 830 vs name bottom 818), and the name is on one line with no overflow. At 390 the name block is 149px and the Speech tag sits to its right (name right about 250, tag left 263) with OT wrapped below. Second row: 164 and 234px. No overlap. (2) The goal-g3 'Not yet observed this month' pill wraps below the OT tag at 320 and stays inside the card (right 231 vs content edge 268) in both Overview and Goals. At 390: right 287 vs 338. (3) Plans: at 320 'Frozen · awaiting authorized review' wraps to 2 lines (h=40) inside the li (right 266 vs 268). At 390 it is one line. (4) Tab focus ring: 3px solid rgb(15,86,146) with outline-offset -3px and :focus-visible true after ArrowLeft. The ring box (325.5–373.5) matches the strip clip box exactly, so it is no longer clipped at 320 or 390. GREETING: family is correct (morning at 08:15 and evening at 21:30, set with page.clock) with zero console warnings. Center and therapist render greeting(new Date()) during SSR, and the h1 has suppressHydrationWarning. React 18 does not patch suppressed text mismatches, so these pages show the SERVER's hour (UTC), not the user's. With the client clock at 08:15 and 21:30 on the same day as the server (server time 17:42 UTC), both showed 'Good afternoon'. Second finding on center: when the client date differs from the server date (client clock on the next day), the trial banner's shortDate(daysFromNow(3)) gives 23 Oct on the server vs 24 Oct on the client. This raises 'Text content did not match' plus 'An error occurred during hydration. The server HTML was replaced with client content' in the console. In practice this can happen for users near midnight in non-UTC timezones. Therapist PageHeader context longDate(new Date()) is suppressed, so it can silently show the server's date. REGRESSION: 6 routes x 5 widths (320/390/768/1024/1440): 30/30 have no horizontal overflow, 0 console errors/warnings, and at >=640px no Pill wraps (height <=28). Family ?theme=dark with JS chunks blocked: the fam surface is rgb(13,18,38) from first paint. More sheet at 390 on family and center: focus goes to more-sheet-close, 10 Tab/Shift+Tab presses stay inside, and Escape closes it and returns focus to bottom-nav-more. Platform: populated 3/2/2/1 with Pending (2)/Decided (2); empty 0/0/0/0 with (0)/(0); error shows '—' and hides counts; loading shows 4 skeletons and hides counts; switching back to populated restores everything.

ui_bugs.issue: The greeting is computed during SSR with the server's clock and timezone (UTC). suppressHydrationWarning on the h1 hides the mismatch, and React 18 then keeps the server text. A user at 08:15 or 21:30 local time sees 'Good afternoon, Maya/Leila' whenever the server hour is 12–18. Fix: compute the greeting and date on the client after mount, as family does (useState<Date|null>(null) + useEffect(() => setNow(new Date()))). Render a neutral placeholder such as 'Hello, Maya' or a skeleton until then, and remove suppressHydrationWarning.

shortDate(daysFromNow(3)) in the trial banner, and probably the centerSessions dates, render during SSR. When the client's local date differs from the server's (users near midnight in non-UTC timezones), React logs 'Text content did not match. Server: 23 Oct Client: 24 Oct' and 'An error occurred during hydration... replaced with client content'. Fix: gate date-dependent content on a client-side 'now', the same pattern as family.

issues: longDate(new Date()) in page-context has suppressHydrationWarning, so it can silently show the server's date instead of the user's. Same root cause as the greeting.

action_items: Center/therapist: compute greeting(now) and longDate(now) only on the client after mount, with a placeholder until then, and drop suppressHydrationWarning on PageHeader title/context. The current SSR text uses the server's UTC hour and is never corrected.
Center: gate the trial-banner and session dates (daysFromNow/shortDate) on the client-side 'now' to avoid the hydration error across a date boundary.
critical_code_review_comments: PageHeader.tsx: suppressHydrationWarning on title/context hides a real correctness bug, not just a warning. React 18 does not patch suppressed text, so the server value stays.

child/page.tsx: min-w-[9rem] on the name blocks plus flex-wrap li fixes Providers and Guardians. GoalList now has a flex-wrap pill row. Pill uses whitespace-normal with sm:whitespace-nowrap and max-w-full. All verified.

success_rate.frontend: 93% (13/14 checks pass; the greeting fails on 2 of 3 pages)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Test the greeting with page.clock.set_fixed_time at an hour in a different bucket from the server's UTC hour (check with `date`). Same-day times show the SSR text bug. A next-day client clock triggers the center hydration error. The family page already gates on a client 'now' and is correct. All child layout fixes and the regression sweep passed in iteration_5. Note: in the child Providers rows the Avatar is also a span.rounded-full, so exclude it when measuring tag overlap.
rca of the issue: Center and therapist are 'use client' pages but are still server-rendered by Next. greeting(new Date()) runs on the server (UTC) and again on the client. The text mismatch is suppressed by suppressHydrationWarning, so React keeps the server DOM text. Reproduce: server time 17:42 UTC, page.clock set to 2026-10-20T08:15 local, open /design-preview/center: the h1 reads 'Good afternoon, Maya'. Mitigation: client-only 'now' state set in useEffect, as in family/page.tsx.
